summary: AC Immune SA filed a Form 6-K announcing the retirement of its CEO, Dr Andrea Pfeifer, effective at the next AGM on June 11, 2026, after 23 years. The Board Chair, Dr Martin Zügel, is appointed interim CEO during the search for a permanent successor. No price, stake, premium, or deal terms are involved. The filing is a non-routine, forced/abrupt leadership transition that itself constitutes the event, distinguishing it from a routine meeting notice. As a foreign private issuer, the Form 6-K reports the material management change; the independent nature of the retirement (not due to disagreement) suggests a planned transition but remains a management change. Watch for the outcome of the CEO search.
